title: Claude adds video analysis for crypto research and due #ClaudeAI #videoresearch #cryptodue
description: Claude introduced a new video analysis skill that transforms crypto research by examining video content frame by frame. Users can upload any crypto-related video and receive exact captions, timestamps, and an accurate transcript to ask detailed questions. This innovation enables faster and more precise due diligence on projects, protocols, and founder interviews by extracting verifiable information straight from the video. It eliminates guesswork and misinformation since Claude’s answers are based purely on the observed footage. For investors and analysts, this tool streamlines reviewing technical breakdowns, tokenomics, and risk factors, making extensive video content actionable in minutes rather than hours. #ClaudeAI #cryptoresearch #videotranscription #defi #tokenomics #dueDiligence #blockchaintech #cryptoanalysis #founderAMA #DeFiProtocol #cryptotools #videointerpretation #cryptoinsights #projectanalysis #tokenlaunch
